what_this_is: The Workshop rows for measuring small models that run on the person's computer (image-text, vision deciders, vision-language and language models, cross-encoders, embedders) on their own material: sampling shots and frames from their format library, labelling and scoring frames against their labels, filling a script template's blanks with sourced phrases, ranking clips for slots, checking takes and ranking titles. Their paths, models, vocabulary and questions are their list:settings rows; the tool carries none.

payload.label: Label frames of my videos with a small model on my computer (runs on your computer)
payload.job: Label sampled frames of my videos with a small model on my computer, from my own shot vocabulary: an image-text model, a vision decider or a vision-language model, and rank free-text places
payload.description: Give shots (with frames), vocabulary ({field: {value: plain definition}}) and the model. label_frames_with_image_text_model asks each value two ways (bare word, plain definition) of an open_clip model; label_frames_with_vision_decider asks a decider-vision snapshot one lettered question per field (questions, context, mode bare | defined), as a two-round tournament past ten values; label_frames_with_vision_language_model asks an mlx-vlm model for one JSON answer per frame (instruction, phrases for free text); rank_free_text_places ranks every distinct reference phrase per frame two ways. Each answer has meta (load seconds, time per frame, memory) and one row per frame. Steps: label_frames_with_image_text_model, label_frames_with_vision_decider, label_frames_with_vision_language_model, rank_free_text_places.

payload.label: Fill a script template's blanks from sourced phrases with small models on my computer (runs on your computer)
payload.job: Fill the blanks of my script template with true, sourced phrases chosen by small models on my computer: gather the phrases, rank them per blank, add the typed candidates, let a model choose, and render the fills with their drift
payload.description: make_candidate_pool gathers short phrases with a checkable source (a listing, a site's JSON, git histories, a product name, ages); template_blanks (read-data) reads the template's lines and blanks; rank_pool_for_blanks keeps a cross-encoder's 12 best per blank; make_typed_options adds every candidate of the blank's type; choose_fills_with_decider, judge_filled_lines_with_decider and choose_fills_with_language_model choose; render_choices_as_fills writes the fills (abstaining below a line) through tool:fill-a-template-without-changing-its-words and measures the drift. A blank of type PERSON-LINE is never filled from a pool. Steps: make_candidate_pool, rank_pool_for_blanks, make_typed_options, choose_fills_with_decider, judge_filled_lines_with_decider, choose_fills_with_language_model, render_choices_as_fills.
